correctness.rationale: Exact Binet fourth-power decomposition yields five characteristic roots, pairwise distinct modulo all p>=7. Invertible Vandermonde and unit coefficients convert divisibility of every window into divisibility of five geometric sums. Constant mode limits valuations to v_p(k); root order and binomial lifting determine them exactly. Primes 2,3,5 are independently excluded/valued by elementary residue patterns. The attached exact verifier passed 960 comparisons for odd k<1200 coprime to 5 and reports no extrapolation.
